message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a dark teal background with red and white text. The word "TEMPO" is prominently displayed in large red block letters at the top. Below, a headline reads "SALING SIKUT PEMBENTUKAN DANANTARA," followed by a paragraph of smaller white text.

The central scene depicts three human figures gathered around a round, orange table. On the left, a man in a white collared shirt holds a plate with a thick slice of cake. The cake is layered with red, black, and white sections, topped with blue "m" lettering on white frosting. He is looking upward with a satisfied expression. To the right, a man in a red shirt leans forward with a wide grin, hands clasped together. In the foreground, the back and side profile of a third man in a dark suit are visible; he rests his chin on his hand, looking toward the table.

On the table sits a larger white plate holding the remaining portion of the cake, which is missing the slice being held. The letters "UMN" in blue are visible on its top surface. The illustration uses a flat, cartoonish style with bold outlines and distinct shadows. Transcribed text includes "Tangan Jokowi di Pilkada," "Kejanggalan Penahanan Tom Lembong," "11-17 NOVEMBER 2024," and "RP 50.000."
